text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "—Dear you."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "Whether this is a letter or a diary, when I think about it, I'm not really sure, but..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "I decided it didn't matter either way, and simply wrote it down to leave a record."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"‘So that when we meet one day, I can tell
you about as many things as possible.’"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"So that I can properly share
the time that 'I' have lived
with you, the one who gave me life."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Last night, the usual four of us
went stargazing."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"‘Even though writing "the usual four of us" still
feels a little complicated to me.’"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "To be honest, I also feel it's getting rather difficult to avoid calling it that at this point."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ""While looking at the stars, Opera O was being pretty noisy for a while, making up random names for them and loudly declaring bogus legends, but...""

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "(Just in case, I went ahead and corrected all of them.)"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"For someone who was the one to suggest going stargazing,
she sure fell asleep quickly, as expected."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "Dotou went to catch her just as she was about to collapse, and in the end, the two of them ended up snuggled together, fast asleep."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"So once again—just like that time at the beach,
Top Road-san was the only one awake."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "We talked a lot about the stars."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "Because you listened so tirelessly, I seem to have gotten carried away and talked a bit too much."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "The next morning, Curren-san laughed at me because my voice was unusually hoarse."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ""And yet, even though they laughed at me, the reason I couldn't bring myself to be as angry as I thought I'd be was...""

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "Because that smile looked... strangely happy."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Regarding Curren, I thought as I wrote this
that I should probably thank her
a little more properly."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: “Well, let's call it a day here.”

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"There's so much more to write,
but I intend to keep writing this
for a long, as long a time as possible."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "I'm really looking forward to the day we can meet."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"However, along the road leading up to that day,
I plan to walk as slowly and steadily as possible."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ‘That's why I'll take it one step at a time.’

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"—Sometimes there are things I want to write, but can't quite put into words,
so they remain unwritten."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Honestly, I wonder how I should write this.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Just that you're kind of hard to figure out.
choice_data_list: Yeah, they told me that at Christmas too...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You're always working so hard, running around just for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
A strange person who just tags along
with someone like me of their own accord.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —I'll just write it like this.
